content.text: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) is the practice of automating the building, testing, and deployment of software to deliver changes to production reliably and frequently. CI/CD forms the backbone of modern software delivery, enabling teams to ship hundreds of changes per day while maintaining stability.
This learning path covers the foundational principles of CI/CD, then dives into practical pipeline design and implementation patterns.

items: CI/CD Fundamentals — Core principles of continuous integration and delivery, automation strategies, and testing practices
CI/CD Pipelines — Pipeline architecture, stage design, deployment strategies, and tooling for production-grade workflows
Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi for automated infrastructure provisioning
Terraform — HCL deep dive, state management, modules, workspaces, and CI/CD integration with Atlantis and Terraform Cloud
